propositions: Move op-cert key acquisition from per-job SSM/boto3 lookup to startup validation and composition, rejecting invalid sources before queue/worker/network/workspace creation
Copy validated key to process-owned 0700/0600 location at startup, never modifying the deployment source and observing replacement only on restart
Replace global environment patching with immutable context-local signer, principal, and push-policy threaded through job/workspace/signing seams to isolate concurrent and timed-out workers

Thread OpcertSigner binding through both out-of-opcert_service/ producer chains (completion sign_completion_verdict and plan-review generation.sign_manifest via _sign_manifest_under_lock/mint_opcert_record) so service-supplied context binding takes precedence over env/genesis

Decouple op-cert application runtime from SSM/boto3/region by removing REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM and key-retrieval region vars, materializing key externally via fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 read-only file, and binding that path via REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH
Preserve Ed25519/DSSE algorithm, trust roots, producer, authoritative fetch, envelope persistence, guard, and no-workspace-push invariants while eliminating per-job global state hazards
